criteria.detail: monthly changes: 3 of 3 shifts reach enough of the 6852 rows to be fitted, 3 of them over at least as many clusters as the fit has coefficients; levels: 3 of 3 shifts reach enough of the 9658 rows to be fitted, 3 of them over at least as many clusters as the fit has coefficients. Each fitted shift runs the real branch series and the shifted one on exactly the rows that shift reaches, so the two standard errors share a sample and a cluster count. A cluster-robust meat matrix is a sum of one outer product per cluster, so with fewer clusters than coefficients it is singular and its standard errors carry nothing; that is arithmetic and not a threshold. An arm with no surviving shift has no floor, and its reading below is not adjudicable rather than failed
criteria.name: B61-0  every comparison is a real fit and a placebo on the same rows, over enough clusters to have a covariance

criteria.detail: 28236 lines, 0 malformed, 6948 of another variety, 369 with an unreadable date or a non-positive price or arrival. 9658 rows kept across 6 states, 121 markets and 1743 days; 11261 rows dropped because their state had fewer than 3 markets reporting that day, so no leave-one-out branch exists for them

criteria.detail: dev and dev_state both subtract nat(t), so they correlate through var(nat) even under independence. corr(dev, dev_state) is 0.2061 raw, -0.0347 under a day fixed effect which absorbs nat(t) exactly, and -0.0087 with a market effect added. The regressions use the absorbed form. corr(dev, log arrivals) is 0.0463 raw and -0.0123 absorbed

criteria.name: B61-4  the rival's regressor: does the deviation load on the region's own conditions
criteria.rival_entailment: If the field is generated that way then, once the day's national level and the market's fixed position are held out, a market's deviation is explained by its own supply conditions, and the identity of the intermediary carries no further information. So the coefficient on the market's own arrivals has to clear a floor built by shifting the intermediary series, and the coefficient on the intermediary must not.
criteria.rival_premise: A distance-weighted equilibrium: the value at a position is set by that position's own conditions and its distance from the anchor. This is the branch B30-5 names in as many words, 'loads on local conditions -> the field is an equilibrium'.

criteria.detail: 9658 rows come from 121 markets in 6 states over 1743 days, and no count in this record is an independent-observation count. Standard errors are clustered on the state, which is the level the branch varies at; the iid figure is in every fit beside the clustered one. The three commodities are downstream of one market system, so a replication across them is not three independent samples
criteria.name: B61-6  what the counts are not

criteria.detail: 180d base z -1.73; dropping Kerala not readable without it, Maharashtra not readable without it, Rajasthan not readable without it; 365d base z -1.04; dropping Maharashtra not readable without it, Rajasthan not readable without it, Telangana not readable without it; 730d base z -2.13; dropping Maharashtra not readable without it, Rajasthan not readable without it, Telangana not readable without it. A cluster count says how many states there are and cannot say how many of them carry the reading, so each is dropped in turn and the figure reprinted. A state holding most of the pairs takes the reading with it when dropped and that says nothing; a state holding few of them and still moving the figure is the one to read. This criterion prints and judges nothing
